body.message:
Hello Amogh,

As per your request, please find the rate below for the 2-bedroom apartment at Elite Business Bay Residences - Business Bay:

For your requested stay from 21st October to 30th November (40 nights), the total rate will be AED 16,500.

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

*
Monthly Rate :
*
October: AED 12,000
November: AED 13,500

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-elite-business-bay-residence-2Q6stHMYs0u.html

*
Please also note that the rate displayed online is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rate is applicable to your requested dates.
*

To secure the booking, the required payment must be completed in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the apartment and confirm the booking.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
